name: Sink gasket 31 / 51
description: Flat sink gasket with a tall sealing rim: 31 mm inner and 51 mm outer diameter. A flat web 1.2 mm thick, flat out to a radius of about 21 mm, then a straight 45 degree ramp up to a rim 5 mm high; the top side is rounded where the web turns up. The underside has a sharp 45 degree bend, so nothing leans less than 45 degrees and it prints without supports. Print in TPU, flat side down.
